about: MM3D (USA) text for the PC (tools/z3dmods/text.py). font: the text font drawn again from Jost (sets/fonts, SIL OFL 1.1). messages: one table a language, each the prompts reworded for our inputs (docs/plans/pc-controls-hud.md, "Layout") in that language's own words. Markup is gmsg.py's: {25:x} is a prompt icon (decomp/mm3d docs/message.md): 1 A, 2 B, 3 X, 4 Y, 5 L (LT), 6 R (RT), 7 START (Menu), 9 the power button's cell (View), 11 the circle pad, and the item buttons 18 and 1B, which the prompt sheet draws as RB and the D-pad (sets/hud/mm3d-usa-rev1.json). 0x0E is the +Control Pad Left's cell, which no message uses, drawn as Pause: LB over Menu, Esc on the keyboard.
